content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR IARI Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 11-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR IARI) for project-based research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Senior Research Fellow (SRF) under various research projects at the institute.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for the Senior Research Fellow positions in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for ICAR IARI SRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to send your application by email is 11-10-2026. Make sure to submit your documents before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the date of the online interview?
faq.answer: The online interview for shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be held on 16-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Agricultural Economics, Dairy Economics, Fisheries Economics, Economics, or Agricultural Statistics with relevant NET and research experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age required is 21 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years, with relaxations provided for reserved categories as per rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive ₹ 37,000 + 27% HRA for the 1st and 2nd year, and ₹ 42,000 + 27% HRA from the 3rd year onwards.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through email. Candidates must send their applications and scanned documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this job?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their essential qualifications, followed by an online interview.
